note: Owner-curated. Each myth is phrased as a claim or question. Every rule in `rules` must have Original: Established. verdict is one of busted, confirmed, depends, unknown. Add an entry here and rebuild; no code changes are needed.

myths.claim: Wearing the Ankh makes the Wanderer visit more often.
myths.answer: Every qualifying outdoor rest gets the same 1 in 4 chance. The rule lists each condition (outdoors, six hours or more, no ambush, cooldown over) and gear is not among them.

myths.claim: The XP from a kill is shared by the party.
myths.answer: All of it goes to whoever lands the killing blow: the creature's maximum HP ÷ 4 + 1.

myths.claim: Posting a guard makes ambushes rarer.
myths.answer: The chance is 1 in 64 per hour either way. A guard matters once you are attacked: the sleepers are woken. Without one, they are not.
Every hour change except the last rolls 1 in 64. A 9-hour rest gets 8 rolls: about an 11.8% chance of at least one ambush.
The level formula has no cap, but every XP gain we have checked stops at 9,999, which is level 8.

myths.claim: The Wanderer can only visit once a month.
myths.answer: The game notes the month of his last visit, but never checks it when deciding whether he can come.

myths.claim: The Wanderer can find you when you camp in a dungeon.
myths.answer: No. A dungeon camp never rolls for him. Only outdoor rests do.
